name: wavy-background
title: Wavy Background
description: A full-screen dark backdrop crossed by five thick, heavily blurred waves that weave over each other in blue, teal, purple and pink. The ribbons drift and reshape continuously with no pointer input.
use: A hero or section backdrop that needs gentle motion with content layered over it.
avoid: Smaller containers: the canvas sizes to the whole window and never stops animating.
a11y: A canvas loop with no reduced-motion check and no text alternative; it runs indefinitely. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black stage with five soft, blurred ribbons in blue, teal, purple and pink stretching horizontally across the upper middle. They weave over and under each other like thick brush strokes, leaving most of the screen plain black.
behaves: The ribbons drift and undulate continuously, slowly changing their curves and never settling. Nothing responds to the pointer, and the motion runs as long as the page is open.
customise: Pass children to layer content on the waves; colours, wave width, blur, speed and opacity are props, while the canvas still spans the window.
weight: heavy: A full-window canvas redraws five blurred waves on every frame.
